metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled the Unified Folders view in Thunderbird by navigating hamburger menu → View → Folders → Unified Folders. Same navigation path is used to enable Favorite Folders.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird hamburger menu, select View submenu, then Folders submenu, and toggle folder pane view options including Favorite Folders.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator closes Thunderbird (so xulstore.json is written to disk), then reads xulstore.json and checks that 'favorite' appears in the folderTree mode string. Initial state has mode='all', so the initial state fails the check. The agent must use View > Folders > Favorite Folders to enable this view.

scoring_breakdown.favorite_view: 1.0 - Favorite Folders view enabled (xulstore.json mode contains 'favorite')

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads xulstore.json folderTree.mode, which is Thunderbird's persistent storage for the folder pane view mode — exactly the right state to verify.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('required_view', '') where expected is the rules dict directly (no wrong .get('rules') anti-pattern), consistent with type='rule' framework behavior.
Substring check 'favorite' in mode is robust: handles both single-mode ('favorite') and potential multi-mode concatenated strings.
Postconfig closes the Thunderbird window before reading xulstore.json, ensuring the file is flushed to disk and reflects the latest UI state.
Initial state has mode='all', so the evaluator has proper negative control resistance — a do-nothing agent will not pass.
Hardcoded profile path (t5q2a5hp.default-release) is appropriate because the task deterministically restores a known profile from thunderbird-profile.tar.gz.
Single instruction requirement (Favorite Folders view enabled) is fully and exclusively covered by the evaluator.
